title: WasteGrab
summary: A smart recycling pickup and rewards platform connecting customers, collectors, and administrators through AI-assisted classification, live operations, routing, achievements, and incentives.
overview: WasteGrab is an Nx monorepo with an Angular 21 frontend, Express API, Prisma 7 data layer, and shared TypeScript domain library. Customers create pickups with multiple images, saved addresses, Roboflow-assisted material estimates, lifecycle tracking, achievements, a recycling leaderboard, reward points, and voucher redemption. Collectors discover and accept work, manage assigned stops, view MapLibre and OSRM route guidance, update arrival and completion states, and verify actual weight. Administrators manage users, collectors, requests, material categories, collection locations, vouchers, achievements, notification campaigns, and authentication artwork. Supabase stores public media, Server-Sent Events and Web Push deliver updates, and Docker, Railway, GHCR, GitHub Actions, Playwright, and Vitest support delivery and testing.
highlights: Full-stack recycling pickup and rewards platform for customers, collectors, and admins (Angular 21, Express, Prisma, MySQL/MariaDB).
Customer journeys cover multi-image pickup requests, saved addresses, AI-assisted estimates, status history, achievements, leaderboards, points, and vouchers.
Roboflow suggests material category, weight, and reward value before submission while keeping the estimate manually adjustable.
Collector operations include available and assigned jobs, distance-aware views, MapLibre and OSRM multi-stop routing, lifecycle updates, and final-weight verification.
Admin modules manage users, collectors, pickups, material categories, collection locations, vouchers, achievements, auth slides, and notification campaigns.
Supabase-backed media, in-app notifications, Server-Sent Events, Web Push, and a points ledger connect operational updates to customer rewards.
Nx, shared TypeScript contracts, Docker, GitHub Actions, GHCR, Railway, Playwright, and Vitest support the monorepo delivery pipeline.
